body: Hardcoded `10.0` divisor in GH-excess penalty (shrimp.rs:1679) and hardcoded `0.3` floor clamp for Ca/Mg factors (shrimp.rs:1684,1689) in `molt_mineral_modifier`. These control the penalty curve shape for high-GH scenarios and the minimum contribution from individual minerals. Extract as named parameters (e.g., `gh_excess_penalty_divisor`, `mineral_factor_floor`).
